As ti will consume only 1 byte at a time, it could take a very long time depending on the global size (think about fuzzed captures). Returning a status code is a one line change that can be easily implemented, and an error should be displayed in the default case.

The abbreviations are hardly understandable IMHO. Does it mean pre configured default configuration NSSAI? BTW NSSAI should be in capital letters (it means Network Slice Selection Assistance Information).

Yes, it is hard to understand it. I believe MO network may have default configured nssai that is called default configued nssai. Modem or OS may have its own, to differentiate the default nssai configured by client(Modem/OS) and MO network, the default nsssai configured by client is called _pre configured default configured nsssai_.
So please use a full description and not weird abbreviation
